## Template A: Checklist for **adding** a package

- [ ] One new recipe per PR (up to 3 new recipes only if tightly related).
- [ ] New recipes target `emscripten-6x` branch.
- [ ] Package requires compilation (not a noarch package). If you have a noarch package, we suggest submitting your recipe to [conda-forge](https://github.com/conda-forge/staged-recipes/) instead.
- [ ] Title: *Add pkg_name*

---

## Template B: Checklist for **updating** a package

- [ ] ⚠️ Bump build number **or** reset build number to 0 when updating to a newer version.
- [ ] Title: *Update pkg_name from x.y.z to x.y.z*
